"Dance for You" is a song by American singer Beyoncé from the deluxe edition of her fourth studio album, 4 (2011).
It was written by Beyoncé, Terius "The-Dream" Nash and Christopher "Tricky" Stewart, while production was handled by the former two.
"Dance for You" is a midtempo R&B song, in which Beyoncé adopts sensual vocals.
4 is the fourth studio album by American singer and songwriter Beyoncé.
It was released on June 24, 2011, by Parkwood Entertainment and Columbia Records.

Recorded from March 2010 to May 2011, the album was produced by Beyoncé alongside Babyface, Jeff Bhasker, Kanye West, Kaskade, Brent Kutzle, and Ryan Tedder of OneRepublic, Switch, and The-Dream, among others.
Beyoncé Giselle Knowles-Carter (  bee-ON-say; née Knowles; born September 4, 1981) is an American singer, songwriter, actress, and businesswoman.
